# Repeated invariant inputs with an array result

Independently authored Collection<T> and Class<T> inputs retain one method-owned
Object formal in T[]. The provider returns a volatile late-selected array; its
size observation and Class name do not determine the returned length, component
or identity. An ordinary parent, static facade and reversed parameter order keep
the exact declaration and original inputs observable.

Source and SDK modes compile every Java8 unit and compare definitions, roles,
Signatures, Exceptions and helpers. Frozen observers repeat 132 fresh-JVM cases
twice, checking null/failure order, untouched collection traversal, late callback
and result changes, mismatched runtime tokens, opaque array identity, original
String[] casts and ignored-result casts. Wrong programs precede recovery and
metadata-only controls retain Code.
